item.title: Emergency Response Plan
item.description: The Chillicothe R-II School Board reviewed the district’s Emergency Response Plan as part of its Executive Session. Superintendent Dr, Dan Wiebers explained why this is done behind closed doors. Emergency plans for weather and for threats. He says it reduces the risk of compounding any issues.

item.title: Local Masters of Education Offered
item.description: A Masters of Education program through Central Methodist University will be offered locally for Chillicothe educators. Superintendent Dr. Dan Wiebers explained the benefits to the district. Take Masters level courses locally and affordably. Wiebers says there may also be opportunities for qualified local educators to be the instructors in these classes.
